foto-01.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: CACE Imatges N1 single-word vocabulary stimulus. Intended concept: CALENT. ONE synthetic studio PHOTOGRAPH. Real camera realism, believable skin texture and hair, soft even neutral studio light. No illustration or cartoon. Subject: No human figure. A different concrete exemplar for this variant.. Visual content: One ceramic mug of hot brown beverage on its small saucer, visibly rising natural delicate steam, unbranded handle, all objects complete. No flames, no person drinking, no kettle, no thermometer. Minimal white studio surface/background. Visually hot, not cold. Variant changes mug shape and color. Rounded blue container or mug. Composition: ONE square image, pure white background, isolated clear subject, Complete objects comfortably inside the frame, generous white margins, no cropped handles or meaningful parts. Minimal context only when essential. NO text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, emoji, decorative symbols, arrows, borders, panels, collages or montage. Anatomically plausible proportions, correct eyes and mouth, no extra limbs or fingers. Appropriate for school use and varied ages. Produce ONE standalone image only.
